svg.title: Initiatives: work that spans teams, above epics — SoftTrack web design mockup (#276)
svg.desc: An epic belongs to one team, so work that takes three teams is three epics that share a name. An initiative belongs to the instance, epics attach to it from any team, and its progress rolls up from them; a viewer sees an epic from a team they are not on as a name, a state and a progress bar.
svg.text: Initiatives: work that spans teams, above epics
· three epics that share a name, made one thing

g.text: an initiative’s page, signed in as Lena, who is on two of them
